name: Domestic Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Bottles Applicability
description: Determines technical relevance of IS 17526:2021 for domestic insulated vacuum beverage containers and checks DPIIT 2023 QCO mandate.

result.qco_order: Insulated Flask, Bottles and Containers for Domestic Use (Quality Control) Order, 2023
result.mandatory_reason: DPIIT Quality Control Order 2023 mandates compulsory ISI marking for domestic vacuum flasks under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016.

sources.publisher: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
